daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query with window functions to calculate: (1) the 30-day moving average of closing price for each stock, (2) the daily price change rank within each stock (highest gain = rank 1), and (3) identify the date when each stock hit its 52-week high. Use ROW_NUMBER() and LAG() window functions. Filter for the top 10 stocks by trading volume. Return columns: stock_code, date, close_price, moving_avg_30d, price_change_rank, weeks_52_high_date. Order by stock_code and date.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data (available from NSW Open Data portal). Write a Python pandas script to: (1) handle missing values in crash severity and contributing factors columns (document your strategy), (2) create new features: crash_hour from datetime, is_weekend boolean, severity_category (ordinal encoding: minor/moderate/serious/fatal), (3) standardise location data by removing duplicates and normalising suburb names to title case, (4) export cleaned dataset to CSV with summary statistics (total crashes, crashes by severity, top 5 suburbs). The script should be robust and handle edge cases like malformed dates.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production Pipeline: SQL Aggregation + Python Export
daily_quests.description: Build a data pipeline using Australian wine production statistics (ABARES or Wine Australia data). Step 1 (SQL): Write a query to aggregate wine production by region and vintage year, calculate year-over-year growth using LAG() window function, and identify the top 3 regions by average production volume over the last 5 years. Step 2 (Python): Read the SQL query results, use pandas to create: (a) a pivot table showing region vs. vintage with production volumes, (b) a bar chart visualization of top regions, (c) export a summary report as CSV with regions, average production, growth trend, and recommendations for high-growth regions. Combine both steps in a single Python script that executes SQL and processes results.
daily_quests.dataset: Australian Wine Production Statistics — Wine Australia (wineaustralia.com) or ABARES (agriculture.gov.au)
